facts.es: En su LinkedIn figura como fundador y CEO de «Blockai (acquired by Pixsy)» de abril de 2013 a junio de 2014, con el lema «Bitcoin Made Simple». La prensa de la época sitúa esas fechas en QuickCoin, que cofundó con Nathan Lands, y Blockai se lanzó en 2016 con Lands como CEO.
facts.en: On his LinkedIn he is listed as founder and CEO of "Blockai (acquired by Pixsy)" from April 2013 to June 2014, with the tagline "Bitcoin Made Simple". Contemporary press places those dates at QuickCoin, which he co-founded with Nathan Lands, and Blockai launched in 2016 with Lands as CEO.

facts.es: Según su LinkedIn, entró en Metallicus en enero de 2020 como vicepresidenta de Finanzas; es directora financiera (CFO) desde octubre de 2020 y miembro del consejo desde enero de 2021.
facts.en: According to her LinkedIn, she joined Metallicus in January 2020 as Vice President of Finance; she has been CFO since October 2020 and a board member since January 2021.

facts.es: Su LinkedIn indica que es CFO de Metallicus sin interrupción desde octubre de 2020, pero el acuerdo con el regulador de Ohio, posterior a octubre de 2022, lo firma Kevin R. Allard con el cargo de CFO.
facts.en: Her LinkedIn says she has been Metallicus's CFO continuously since October 2020, but the agreement with the Ohio regulator, dated after October 2022, is signed by Kevin R. Allard with the title of CFO.
